Fix the comparison-page preview template in /opt/nxeon-staging (staging). Target: `components/marketing/comparisontemplate/*` + `app/(marketing)/preview/comparison/page.tsx` (Nxeon vs DigitalOcean).

TASKS:
1. **The head-to-head comparison table reads "dodgy"/not credible — fix it.** Study the EXISTING live comparison table `components/marketing/CompareTable.tsx` + `components/marketing/ComparePageLayout.tsx` (the real comparison pages) for the established, credible row structure/copy, and bring the preview table up to that standard: honest, specific, well-organized rows (price, specs, support, features), clear win/tie treatment, a disclaimer. Make it genuinely believable, not marketing fluff.
2. **Use REAL competitor logos.** The existing `components/marketing/CompetitorLogo.tsx` resolves real logos from `/public/logos/<slug>.svg` (falling back to built-in simple-icons path data). Use it for the competitor (DigitalOcean) instead of a text wordmark. It's server-only (node:fs) — so render the logo in the server page/wrapper and pass it in, OR (cleaner) if a `/public/logos/<slug>.svg` is missing, download the real SVG (e.g. `curl -s -o public/logos/digitalocean.svg https://www.vectorlogo.zone/logos/digitalocean/digitalocean-icon.svg`) and reference `/logos/digitalocean.svg` directly. Make the approach generic so future competitor comparisons (vs Vultr, Shockbyte, Bluehost, etc.) can drop in a logo the same way. Nxeon's own mark is `/logo.png`.

SHARED (apply): Replace any plain star/StarRow review element with the EXISTING `components/marketing/ReviewBadges.tsx` (the real Trustpilot/HostAdvice/Google component). Replace emoji glyphs with icons from `components/marketing/icons.tsx`. Ensure the preview page has proper metadata (title/description/canonical/OG) and add relevant JSON-LD schema (a comparison is well-suited to FAQ schema + Product/Offer). Do NOT edit `app/globals.css` (use CSS Modules/inline; reuse existing `pv-*` keyframes). NET-NEW/own-template files only — don't touch other templates or shared components (READ them for reference; `ReviewBadges`/`CompetitorLogo`/`icons` are imported, not modified). Verify `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build` or a dev server (main session screenshots). Report what you changed + any logo you had to download.
